```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/ecocast.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
navigation = data.get("navigation", {})
cards = data.get("cards", [])

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def page_url(value):
    """Convert internal .qmd links to rendered .html links."""
    value = str(value or "")
    parts = urlsplit(value)

    if parts.path.endswith(".qmd"):
        parts = parts._replace(
            path=parts.path[:-4] + ".html"
        )

    return urlunsplit(parts)

def image_url(value):
    """Resolve image paths relative to the EcoCast directory."""
    value = str(value or "")

    if value.startswith(("https://", "http://", "/")):
        return value

    return str(PurePosixPath(value))

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# NAVIGATION
# ----------------------------------------------------------

nav_links = ""

for link in navigation.get("links", []):
    nav_links += f"""
    <a class="cw-ecocast-tab"
       href="{safe(page_url(link.get('url')))}">
      {safe(link.get('label'))}
    </a>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PROJECT CARDS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

card_html = ""

for card in cards:
    card_html += f"""
    <article class="cw-ecocast-card">

      <h3>{safe(card.get('title'))}</h3>

      <p>{safe(card.get('description'))}</p>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-card-btn"
         href="{safe(page_url(card.get('button_url')))}">
        {safe(card.get('button_label'))}
        <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
      </a>

    </article>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-ecocast">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-ecocast-topbar">

    <a class="cw-ecocast-brand" href="ecocast.html">
      <img
        src="{safe(image_url(navigation.get('logo')))}"
        alt="{safe(navigation.get('logo_alt'))}"
      >
    </a>

    <nav class="cw-ecocast-tabs"
         aria-label="EcoCast navigation">
      {nav_links}
    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-hero">

    <img
      src="{safe(image_url(hero.get('image')))}"
      alt="{safe(hero.get('image_alt'))}"
      class="cw-ecocast-hero-image"
    >

    <div class="cw-ecocast-hero-overlay">

      <span class="cw-ecocast-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

    </div>

    <span class="cw-ecocast-image-caption">
      {safe(hero.get('image_caption'))}
    </span>

  </section>

  <!-- PROJECT RESOURCES -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-section">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-card-grid">
      {card_html}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
